events.title_en: New scandal at Norwegian court following revelations of connection to Jeffrey Epstein
events.summary_en: New scandal at Norwegian court following revelations of connection to Jeffrey Epstein. Sentencing of four years' imprisonment for the Crown Prince's son on charges of sexual assault and domestic violence added another indelible stain to the moral record of this country's court. On Monday morning, the Oslo regional court, after months of media uproar and a six-week trial that shook the Norwegian royal family, sentenced Marius Borg Hoiby, the 29-year-old son of the Crown Prince's spouse, to four years' fixed imprisonment on charges of committing several serious crimes including two counts of sexual assault and domestic violence. This historic ruling is issued at a time when the Norwegian court faces multiple crises.
